falseSynonyms.zh: 有禮不等於 formal polite 關乎禮貌；formal 關乎正式程度、場合或規範。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Politeness and formality overlap but are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 嚴肅不等於 formal serious 表示態度認真；正式場合可以輕鬆，嚴肅內容也可以很非正式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Seriousness is not the same as formality.

falseSynonyms.zh: 專業不等於 formal professional 強調工作標準與能力；formal 強調場合、語氣或程序。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Professional may be formal, but the meanings differ.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傳統不等於 formal traditional 強調歷史習慣；formal 不一定傳統。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Traditional concerns custom; formal concerns formality.

falseSynonyms.zh: 複雜不等於 formal formal 語言或程序可以很簡單；complex 只是複雜程度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Complexity and formality are unrelated dimensions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 法律上的不等於 formal legal 表示符合法律或涉及法律；formal 可能完全不涉及法律。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Legal is narrower and law-specific.

falseSynonyms.zh: official 只在機構／權威 sense 接近 formal official 是由權威認可或發布；正式語氣、服裝不一定 official。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Official concerns authority; formal is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 formal 是形容詞；formality 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Formal is an adjective; formality is a noun.
